facts.fact: The Presidential Delivery Unit's Digitalization Labs of 25 April to 10 May 2022 produced a draft National ICT & Digitalization Policy roadmap, with 120 stakeholders consulted and a drafting team led by the Ministry of ICT & Digitalization; the timeline says it will be published by July 2022.
The draft is titled 2022-2026 and every strategy in its implementation plan carries the time frame 2022-2026, though one page calls the resulting policy '2022 to 2027'.
The draft's implementation plan lists strategies per priority area across nine priority areas, each with a time frame of 2022-2026 and responsibility mostly marked 'TBC', and states no cost.

The draft names the Ministry of Information, Communication, Technology & Digitalization as responsible for the policy's formulation, monitoring and evaluation, and proposes restructuring the Department of E-Government into a Malawi Information Technology Agency under the ministry.
The draft ties no budget line to the policy; it lists as a strategy the development of a policy providing for an ICT levy or a proportion of the national budget for ICT development.

The draft's private-sector analysis cites a survey in which 21 percent of key stakeholders reported being unaware of the national ICT Policy 2013; no adoption date is given, so the policy's year in its name is used.
